exposure: Planned place of birth (home vs. hospital)
outcome: Neonatal resuscitation requiring positive pressure ventilation
Composite outcome of severe neonatal mortality and morbidity and maternal mortality and morbidity
cohort: 4741 midwifery clients with at least one prior cesarean birth who delivered between April 2000 and March 2017
finding: Planned home births for women eligible for vaginal birth after cesarean (VBAC) were associated with a significantly lower cesarean birth rate compared to planned hospital VBACs.
mod_finding: Planned home births for women eligible for VBAC were associated with a significantly lower cesarean birth rate compared to planned hospital VBACs.
